tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV/MCH/MCHC), with normal leukocyte and platelet counts. The markedly elevated platelet distribution width may indicate increased platelet size variability, possibly reflecting reactive changes. Correlation with clinical context and further evaluation for anemia etiology is recommended.
